manifest.name: dsh-agent-teams-dashboard
manifest.description: AgentTeams dashboard for the DSH Web UI: a «Команды» sidebar section with team cards, token spend by range, USD/RUB cost, work time and an archive of older teams.
manifest.author: dadgrand <dadgrand@users.noreply.github.com>

bundle.text:
# Bundle patch for dsh-agent-teams-dashboard.
#
# One host row. The host half (index.js) registers the dashboard's two
# loopback-only JSON routes on the composition's webServer carrier:
#
#   GET /api/dsh-teams-dashboard/snapshot   aggregated dashboard payload
#   GET /api/dsh-teams-dashboard/status     diagnostic counters
#
# and the browser half (package.json -> dsh.client) adds the «Команды»
# sidebar entry plus the panel that renders that payload. Nothing else in the
# composition changes.
#
# Maintenance: keep exactly one insert row here. Removing the row (or the
# link: dependency in the profile) and restarting the host unmounts the plugin.
- insert:
    - id: teams-dashboard
      name: 'dsh-agent-teams-dashboard'

readme.text:
A DSH Web plugin that adds a **Teams** section («Команды») to the sidebar and a
dashboard for every AgentTeams chat: active runs and teams finished in the last
three days, token spend with time-range controls, cost in USD and RUB, total and
union work time, team cards with the orca roster and task roadmap, and an
archive for older teams.

The plugin has two halves: a host half (`index.js` + `lib/host/`) that reads DSH
and AgentTeams state read-only and serves two loopback JSON routes, and a
browser half (`lib/client.js`) that renders the panel inside the DSH shell. The
panel never talks to the outside world: it calls its own same-origin route.

Both screenshots come from the offline preview harness with synthetic demo data;
no owner data is used anywhere in this repository.

- Sidebar section «Команды» (panel id `agent-teams-dashboard`, order 10) with a
  live dot while a team is working.
- Ranges: Today, 7 days (default), 30 days, All time and a custom period picker.
- Three hero cards: tokens (cache / input / output, stacked by day), cost
  (USD primary, RUB always visible, CBR rate with date and stale/override
  markers) and time (total work time plus the merged "online" time).
- Team grid: title that shrinks 13 → 12 → 11 px and clamps to two lines, a
  coloured status dot with a word (active, waiting, halted, stalled, completed,
  unknown), captain and member orca artwork with a monogram fallback, a
  dependency-ordered task roadmap with a segmented progress bar, and a one-line
  metrics footer.
- Archive view with search by title and sorting by end date, title or spend;
  older teams are also reachable from the sticky bottom button.
- Clicking a card or an archive row opens the team chat (the captain session)
  through the shell navigation; a missing session shows a toast instead of
  navigating.
- Skeleton, empty, range-empty, error, stale and partial states; one broken
  `team.json` never blanks the dashboard — it becomes a warning strip while t

Requirements: DSH Web with client-plugin support (`dsh.engines.dsh >= 0.2.0-rc.2`)
and, for the data itself, the AgentTeams plugin (`@nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams`).

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add --save-exact git+https://github.com/dadgrand/dsh-agent-teams-dashboard.git#v0.1.0
```

Replace `<profile>` with your DSH profile name (for the Desktop app the default
profile is usually `desktop`). Restart the host when the command finishes; the
loader mounts the plugin's `cordis.patch.yml` row automatically.

readme.section: Install from the Desktop plugin manager
readme.text:
Open **Settings → Plugins**, choose "Install from Git URL" and paste:

```text
git+https://github.com/dadgrand/dsh-agent-teams-dashboard.git#v0.1.0
```

Confirm the install and restart the host. The plugin appears in the sidebar as
«Команды».

`<DSH_HOME>` defaults to `%USERPROFILE%\\.dsh` on Windows and `~/.dsh` on
macOS/Linux.

Every setting is optional; without a `config` block the plugin mounts with the
defaults below. Override them in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: teams-dashboard
  name: 'dsh-agent-teams-dashboard'
  config:
    archiveDays: 5

| Key | Default | Allowed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stateDir` | `.agent-teams` | non-empty string | AgentTeams state directory inside each workspace. |
| `timeZone` | empty | IANA zone | Zone used for day keys; empty means the host zone. |
| `defaultRange` | `today` | `today`, `7d`, `30d`, `all`, `custom` | Range used when a request carries none (the panel always sends its own; its default is 7 days). |
| `defaultCurrency` | `usd` | `usd`, `rub` | Headline currency when a request carries none. |
| `archiveDays` | `3` | integer 1…365 | Days without activity before a live team moves to the archive (the panel requests 3). |
| `idleGapMs` | `300000` | integer 1000…86400000 | Gap between events that closes an activity interval. |
| `activeWindowMs` | `120000` | integer 1000…86400000 | Window in which a member counts as working. |
| `snapshotTtlMs` | `15000` | integer 0…3600000 | Snapshot cache lifetime. |
| `concurrency` | `8` | integer 1…32 | Parallel file reads while building a snapshot. |
| `maxLogBytes` | `67108864` | integer 65536…1073741824 | Logs larger than this are read from the tail. |
| `fxEnabled` | `true` | boolean | Allow CBR rate fetches; `false` uses the last cach

The rates can also be supplied through the environment variables
`DSH_TEAMS_DASHBOARD_USD_RUB` and `DSH_TEAMS_DASHBOARD_CNY_RUB`; a manual rate
marks the snapshot as an override.

It never reads message content, never reads the AgentTeams mailboxes
(`inbox/*.jsonl` is out of scope), sends no telemetry and writes exactly one
file: the exchange-rate cache at
`<DSH_HOME>/cache/dsh-teams-dashboard/fx.json`. That file is safe to delete.

The only outbound requests are the two CBR endpoints:

- `https://www.cbr.ru/scripts/XML_daily.asp` (primary);
- `https://www.cbr-xml-daily.ru/daily_json.js` (fallback).

Disable them with `fxEnabled: false`; the plugin then uses the last cached rate
or the baked rate and marks the snapshot as stale. Both panel routes answer only
on loopback (127.0.0.1 / ::1): a remote caller gets `403 forbidden:
loopback-only`. Nothing is sent anywhere else.

The public repository and its fixtures/screenshots contain synthetic demo data
only. `scripts/check-public.mjs` enforces this before every release.

- DSH Web `>= 0.2.0-rc.2` with client-plugin support (the `dsh.client` bundle
  entry and `sidebar.panellist` / `main` slots).
- Node.js 24 or newer for the test suite, the checks and the offline preview
  harness; the plugin itself has no runtime dependencies.
- AgentTeams (`@nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams`) is optional to mount but required
  for data: without it the dashboard is empty, and the whale artwork falls back
  to monogram badges.
- Windows, macOS and Linux. Windows paths are handled with `path.join`/`resolve`
  and the same long-path encoding DSH uses.

**The «Команды» row does not appear.** Check that the plugin is in
`dsh.profile.bundles`, that the git spec resolved (look for install errors in
the plugin manager), that the host was restarted, and that the row id
`teams-dashboard` is present in the loader output.

**The panel opens but shows no teams.** The AgentTeams plugin may be missing, or
the active workspace has no `.agent-teams` directory yet. Create a team with
`/agent-teams` in a chat. Teams are only found under registered workspaces.

**A remote browser gets 403.** The routes are fenced to loopback by design. Use
the dashboard on the same machine as the host.

**Rubles show «—» or a stale rate.** The CBR request failed and no cache exists
(or you disabled FX). Set `usdRub`/`cnyRub` manually or keep the host online.

**Avatars are monograms.** The installed AgentTeams plugin was not found at
`/plugins/dsh-agent-teams/assets/`; this is the designed fallback.

**The first load takes a few seconds.** A cold snapshot reads 18 team records,
session caches and logs; later requests hit a 15-second snapshot cache. Warm
requests are milliseconds.

**Checks fail locally.** Run them from the repository root with Node 24:
`node --test`, `node scripts/check-package.mjs`, `check-bundle`,
`check-preview` and `check-public`. The preview and screenshot scripts need the
vendored assets that ship in `preview/vendor/`.

- Tokens and cost are day-grained: DSH's `contextActivity` only stores daily
  buckets, so "Today" is one bar and sub-day cost is not available.
- Cost is an estimate from the published DeepSeek CNY prices and the dated CBR
  rate, not a provider invoice. Unknown provider/models count tokens but leave
  cost empty ("—", never 0).
- RUB depends on the exchange rate; offline with no cache the baked rate is used
  and marked stale.
- The routes are loopback-only; a remote Web UI receives 403.
- Teams are discovered only under registered workspace paths; a stray
  `.agent-teams` directory is counted, not rendered.
- Removed members stay in history and attribution but never count as live.
- Long archives are not virtualised; `content-visibility: auto` is the only
  mitigation.
- Artwork comes from the installed AgentTeams plugin; missing images degrade to
  monograms.
- The preview harness mounts the real bundle in a mock shell; it does not
  exercise the real shell's navigation service, focus ring or slot geometry.

```bash
node --test                                   # unit and smoke tests
node scripts/check-package.mjs                # manifest, exports, patch row, README
node scripts/check-bundle.mjs                 # browser bundle and dictionaries
node scripts/check-preview.mjs                # offline fixtures and harness wiring

The offline harness in `preview/` loads the real `lib/client.js` through a
`window.__ModuleLoader__` stub, with vendored React 18.3.1 UMD and synthetic
fixtures. Open `preview/index.html` directly, or run
`node scripts/screenshot-preview.mjs` for headless captures of
`preview/screenshot-desktop.png` (1440×900) and `preview/screenshot-mobile.png`
(390×844). The public copies in `docs/screenshots/` are taken from the same
synthetic fixture.

The whale artwork shown on team cards comes from
[`@nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams`](https://github.com/nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams)
(MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 程序员阿江 (Relakkes)) and is loaded from the installed
AgentTeams plugin at runtime; the copies under `preview/vendor/agent-teams/` are
used by the offline harness only. React 18.3.1 UMD (MIT, Copyright (c) Facebook,
Inc. and its affiliates) is vendored for the preview harness and is not part of
the plugin itself. See `preview/vendor/README.md` for versions and SHA-256
digests.
